title: Baton
description:
Agent scheduler state, validated run consumption, native Codex telemetry and Tempo traces. Incremental coverage for issue #142; unavailable pipeline/quality/pricing data is explicitly identified. Provider quota snapshots include 5h/weekly balances, runner headroom, resets and independent observation freshness.

**Live telemetry from $host.** State refreshes every minute. Daily counters follow **America/Los_Angeles** and include manual runs. Current executions and Agent activity always show all Agents. Agent/Role filters apply to quota/usage panels and run summaries; task history spans all vendors.

Task episodes and events start after their instrumentation rollout. Earlier runs are not backfilled. Task identity links review, CI, handoff and run consumption. Missing data is **N/A / Unknown**. Pricing, quality-rate cohorts and CI/dispatch live health are still pending.

Dashboard updates are managed in Git and applied automatically by Argo CD.

panels.title: Agent activity
panels.description: X: time; Y: Agent. Green Active = an agent invocation overlapped the preceding observed collection interval, including short runs completed between polls. Gray Idle = no invocation overlapped that observed interval. Orange Unknown = failed/stale collection or a gap over 150 seconds. This is interval activity, not exact run boundaries or current process state; see Current executions for what is running now. About one-minute collection resolution; range aggregation preserves active buckets when zooming out, which can widen visible activity blocks. Existing missed instantaneous samples are not backfilled. All Agents remain visible regardless of Agent/Role filters. Before interval rollout, available legacy instantaneous observations are retained and may omit short runs.

targets.expr: (clamp_max((max by (agent) (max_over_time(baton_activity_in_interval{hostname="$host"}[$__interval])) or on(agent) max by (agent) (max_over_time(baton_running_by_agent{hostname="$host"}[$__interval]))), 1) and on() (max(baton_state_collect_success{hostname="$host"}) == 1 and (time() - max(baton_activity_observed_at_seconds{hostname="$host"})) < 150 and max(up{job="$node_job",hostname="$host"}) == 1)) or on(agent) (label_replace(vector(-1), "agent", "claude", "", "") or label_replace(vector(-1), "agent", "cursor", "", "") or label_replace(vector(-1), "agent", "codex", "", ""))

panels.title: Retrospective activity
panels.description: Independent retrospective worker on this host, including catch-up checks and task analysis. Green = working; gray = idle; orange = unavailable or stale observation. Samples the default STATE/retrospectives/worker.lock about once per minute without taking the workload lock. Completed analysis attempts overlapping each observed interval remain visible even between samples. Very short checks can be missed. Gaps over 150 seconds are not reconstructed. Zooming out preserves sampled work but may widen visible blocks. Custom --work-state invocations are not included.

targets.expr: (max(max_over_time(baton_retrospective_activity_in_interval{hostname="$host"}[$__interval])) and on() (max(baton_state_collect_success{hostname="$host"}) == 1 and (time() - max(baton_retrospective_observed_at_seconds{hostname="$host"})) < 150 and max(up{job="$node_job",hostname="$host"}) == 1)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Quota balances by provider
panels.description: Account/provider quota, shared across model calls; not per-model budgets. Headroom (pp) is percentage points of account quota below the configured weekly cap. Quota gate does not predict role/PR selection. Stale balances are last observed values. Reset-pending/unknown balances are N/A. Cursor has no 5h quota window. Age is time since the last observation or authentication check. Reset is time until the window resets. Observation ages appear beside each balance and are independent for the two provider windows. Credential status shows the latest authentication result; check results age to Stale after 24 hours, while an explicit authentication failure remains visible until a later success.

panels.title: Current executions
panels.description: Latest observed agent CLI invocations across all Agents; overview ignores Agent/Role filters. Running means a reconciled invocation is alive, including time waiting for tools or network. Idle means no instrumented invocation. Unknown means collection failed, exporter unavailable or observation older than 150 seconds. Uninstrumented manual CLIs are excluded. Updated about once per minute. Task links appear where metadata is available.

targets.expr: (clamp_max(max by (agent) (baton_running_by_agent{hostname="$host"}), 1) and on() (max(baton_state_collect_success{hostname="$host"}) == 1 and (time() - max(baton_activity_observed_at_seconds{hostname="$host"})) < 150 and max(up{job="$node_job",hostname="$host"}) == 1)) or on(agent) (label_replace(vector(-1), "agent", "claude", "", "") or label_replace(vector(-1), "agent", "cursor", "", "") or label_replace(vector(-1), "agent", "codex", "", ""))

label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_join((time() - max by (agent, role, stage, repo, issue, pr, run_id) (baton_current_execution_started_seconds{hostname="$host"})) and on() (max(baton_state_collect_success{hostname="$host"}) == 1 and (time() - max(baton_activity_observed_at_seconds{hostname="$host"})) < 150 and max(up{job="$node_job",hostname="$host"}) == 1), "repo_issue", ";", "repo", "issue"), "issue_link", "[$2](https://github.com/$1/issues/$2)", "repo_issue", "(.+);([1-9][0-9]*)"), "repo_pr", ";", "repo", "pr"), "pr_link", "[$2](https://github.com/$1/pull/$2)", "repo_pr", "(.+);([1-9][0-9]*)")

options.content:
**5h / Weekly Remaining** = account quota left in the provider window. Weekly resets follow the provider, not calendar weeks. **Runner Left (pp)** = max(weekly cap − used, 0), in percentage points of account quota. Limits come from the runner's effective configuration.

**Fresh / Stale** refer to each window’s last successful observation; stale balances retain that value. **Reset pending / Unknown / Unsupported** show N/A until data is available. Cursor has no quota source. Probe attempts do not refresh observation times. **Quota Gate** covers quota and cooldown only; role rules, PR contributions and reviewer exclusions also affect dispatch.

panels.title: 5h Remaining History
panels.description: Last observed quota remaining. Stale values retain their last observation; reset-pending and unknown values leave gaps. No extrapolation or calendar-week aggregation. History starts at deployment.

panels.title: Weekly Remaining History
panels.description: Last observed quota remaining. Stale values retain their last observation; reset-pending and unknown values leave gaps. No extrapolation or calendar-week aggregation. History starts at deployment.

panels.title: Runner lock
panels.description: A held lock can represent CLI work, CI waits, dispatch or a runner started before instrumentation. It does not by itself prove a healthy agent invocation.

panels.title: Instrumented CLI runs
panels.description: Known instrumented CLI invocations only. Zero does not mean the runner is idle; check the lock. Interrupted invocations are reconciled by the independent collector.

panels.title: State age
panels.description: Age since the last successful independent state read. Unknown if it has never succeeded.

panels.title: Alloy self scrape
panels.description: Last received independent self-scrape value. Check sample age below; a stale Up sample is not current health.

panels.title: Summary export to Alloy
panels.description: Local collector acceptance, not a guarantee of durable backend storage. Stable event IDs support deduplication.

panels.title: Last scheduled tick age
panels.description: Unknown before the first instrumented scheduled tick. Paused and lock-busy ticks still record their start. No NoTick alert is enabled.

panels.title: /tmp used
panels.description: The host's /tmp is a tmpfs (half the RAM) with a per-user quota; when it fills, runs and deploys fail with "Disk quota exceeded" (#248). The agent user writes nearly all of it, so the mount total stands in for that user's quota use. node_exporter filesystem collector; display only, no alert.

panels.description: The host's /tmp is a tmpfs (half the RAM) with a per-user quota; when it fills, runs and deploys fail with "Disk quota exceeded" (#248). The agent user writes nearly all of it, so the mount total stands in for that user's quota use. node_exporter filesystem collector; display only, no alert.

panels.title: Runs today
panels.description: Actual runner daily counters, including manual invocations and CLI launches that fail before producing usage. These are distinct from completed summaries.

panels.title: Configured daily cap
panels.description: Read from current runner configuration; manual invocations bypass the scheduled cap. No quota is changed by monitoring.

panels.title: Cooldown remaining
panels.description: Zero means no remaining cooldown. Unknown means a state read failed.

panels.title: Runs today by agent
panels.description: Local-date counters reset at the host's midnight, including idle periods.

panels.title: Scheduled cap utilization
panels.description: May exceed 100% because manual invocations bypass the cap. A missing/zero cap is unavailable, not unlimited.

options.content: Exact run consumption below uses **one stable event ID per invocation** and deduplicates retries. Native counters are not added to these totals. Only `usage_state=complete` contributes to the token totals; partial / unavailable usage remains visible in the table. Missing token categories, actual summary model and price are unavailable. The table is limited to the latest 500 matching records.

Input includes cache reads; cache is a subset, so do not add the input and cached lines. Reasoning is a subset of output. These native trends are separate from the exact run summaries above. panels.title: Recent run traces
panels.description: Run traces only; multi-tick pipeline episodes and CI spans are not yet implemented. Open a trace ID to inspect native Codex child spans and use Tempo trace-to-logs correlation.

options.content:
**Available:** scheduler state, daily launches/caps/cooldowns, run summaries, Codex native telemetry, per-run traces, and task episode/event collection from its rollout.

Task history keeps the latest snapshot per episode within the latest 500 matching log records. Active means no terminal event observed. Each handoff ends an episode; resumed work receives a new Task ID. Review events identify completed verdicts, not CLI exit success. Task Token categories are N/A when usage is incomplete; native counters must not be added to summaries.

**Still pending:** live Claude/Cursor usage verification/native integration, model pricing, CI/dispatch live execution health, quality-rate cohorts and alert rollout. Manual actions outside runner control are not inferred. Task/run event retention follows Loki; per-run traces follow Tempo. Workflow/config hashes identify changes, not their quality or task difficulty. Raw metadata is available through Loki Explore links.

**Collect and display only (#227):** no scheduling, quota or vendor preference reads these numbers.

Episodes that ended in the last 30 days, from the runner's task ledger; `telemetry-validation/*` repositories are excluded. The **author** is the vendor of the episode's first successful dev run (else its first dev run); `owner` is a PR with no agent dev run; spec-only episodes are not counted. **Author model** is the model the dev run actually used (from its log); runs before 2026-10-27 show `unknown`. Every rate shows its sample size **n** next to it. Tokens are summed over runs with complete usage only; runs with partial or missing usage are counted, never treated as zero. Token counts are not comparable across vendors as cost. Post-merge outcomes come from a separate 6-hourly timer (`baton-postmerge`), final 14 days after merge.

panels.title: Implementation by author vendor and model
panels.description: One row per implementing vendor and the model its dev run used. n = ended episodes. Merged / handoff rates are shares of n. First-round pass uses the first review verdict of each episode (n shown). Review rounds, time and tokens are per merged episode. Tokens exclude cache reads and cover complete runs only; Incomplete runs counts merged-episode runs without complete usage. Post-merge columns use merged PRs whose 14 days after merge have passed (n shown): a merged revert PR, or a `bug`-labelled issue in the same repository that references the PR. Label a regression `bug` and mention the PR for it to count.

targets.expr: sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host",outcome="merged"}) or 0 * sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host"})

(sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host",outcome="abnormal_handoff"}) or 0 * sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host"})) / sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host"})

(sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host",outcome="planned_handoff"}) or 0 * sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host"})) / sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host"})

(sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_first_review{hostname="$host",verdict="pass"}) or 0 * sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_first_review{hostname="$host"})) / sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_first_review{hostname="$host"})
sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_review_rounds{hostname="$host"}) / sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host",outcome="merged"})
sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_duration_seconds{hostname="$host"}) / sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host",outcome="merged"})

sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_merged_tokens{hostname="$host",type=~"input|cache_write|output|reasoning"}) / sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_tasks{hostname="$host",outcome="merged"})
sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_merged_runs{hostname="$host",usage_state="incomplete"}) or 0 * sum by (author, author_model) (baton_contrib_merged_runs{hostname="$host"})

panels.title: Handoffs by author and reason
panels.description: Ended episodes handed to the owner, by implementing vendor and runner reason code. auto_merge_off and manual_checks are planned handoffs; the rest are abnormal.

panels.title: Reviews by reviewer vendor
panels.description: PR review verdicts in ended episodes, by reviewing vendor. Must-fix items are the numbered entries under the review's "## Must fix" heading, recorded from 2026-10-27; reviews without a count are excluded from Must-fix per review (its n is shown). Adopted / rejected comes from the fixer's `## Must fix` answers to that round's review (recorded from 2026-10-27); owner rejections are not counted.

targets.expr: (sum by (reviewer) (baton_contrib_reviews{hostname="$host",verdict="changes"}) or 0 * sum by (reviewer) (baton_contrib_reviews{hostname="$host"})) / sum by (reviewer) (baton_contrib_reviews{hostname="$host"})

panels.title: Runs by vendor, role and model
panels.description: Every run that ended in the last 30 days, task or not. Model is what the run's own log reports (Codex: its session rollout; Claude: stream-json init; Cursor reports only Auto, shown as unknown). Token averages are per run with complete usage (n shown). Use with #245 to compare Codex models per role.

targets.expr: (sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_runs{hostname="$host",status="success"}) or 0 * sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_runs{hostname="$host"})) / sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_runs{hostname="$host"})
sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_tokens{hostname="$host",type="input"}) / sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_complete_runs{hostname="$host"})
sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_tokens{hostname="$host",type="cache_read"}) / sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_complete_runs{hostname="$host"})
sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_tokens{hostname="$host",type=~"output|reasoning"}) / sum by (agent, role, model) (baton_model_complete_runs{hostname="$host"})
